default.note: Finite weighted-space and labelled-graph primitives have their literal finite combinatorial meanings.

fg_event_at_least_ratio.note: A threshold on one finite space, not a with-high-probability notion. Do not use it to encode almost-all or whp claims.

fg_event_at_most_ratio.note: A threshold on one finite space, not an asymptotic probability notion.

default.note: The module supplies a finite rotation-system surface, not a drawing/crossing layer; consumers must respect connectedness and cellular-embedding assumptions.

surface_dart.note: Directed darts of the undirected edge relation.

surface_edge_perm.note: The involutive edge permutation on darts.

surface_face_perm.note: Face permutation induced by rotation and dart reversal.

clustered_colouring.note: A k-colouring whose monochromatic connected sets have size at most the explicit bound c.

surface_embeddable_with_boundary.note: The boundary witness can be empty, so the boundary parameter is vacuous.

clustered_chromatic_at_most.note: Its graph-local existential clustering bound is vacuous for finite graphs when used as a class-uniform conclusion; quantify c before the graph class instead.

default.note: Output and cost are coupled through one fixed interpreter; no independently chosen zero-cost function exists.
Finite graph-distance, metric-line, deletion, and bridge primitives have their literal meanings; this module does not provide coarse asymptotic dimension or shallow minors.
Natural-valued eventual O/Omega/Theta and epsilon-free little-o/subpolynomial predicates retain their stated two-sided or quantified meanings.
Weighted and unweighted request satisfaction use explicit positive rational parameters and proper list colourings.
Finite poset, cover graph, realizer, and dimension vocabulary has its standard finite meaning.

girth_geq.note: Lower bound on lengths of genuine undirected cycles.

has_girth.note: Exact girth: a witnessed g-cycle plus the lower-bound predicate.

wagner_planar.note: Finite simple-graph planarity through Wagner's forbidden-minor characterization.

poly_reduces.note: Relational reduction vocabulary with a decoupled abstract cost function; unsuitable for positive algorithm-existence claims.

in_NP.note: The verifier and verifier-cost function are decoupled. Use only as an abstract relational layer until GTBase gains a coupled NP verifier.

NP_hard.note: Machine-free relational hardness layer; acceptable only when the claim is explicitly at that abstraction level.
